summary: Context.dev's free tier includes 1,000 API credits per month (1 credit = 1 page scrape; extraction/brand calls cost more) plus a one-time 10K Logo Link quota — no credit card required. Rate limit is 30 calls/minute with a work email or 10/minute with a personal email.
claim_steps: Sign up at context.dev/signup — no credit card required.
1,000 API credits renew monthly; the 10K Logo Link quota is one-time.
Register with a work email for 30 calls/minute; personal emails get 10/minute.

social_proof.title: Pricing - Simple & Scalable Plans | Context.dev
social_proof.text: Start with 1,000 free credits/mo, no credit card required. The free tier includes 1,000 API credits per month plus 10K one-time Logo Link requests. Free is 30 calls/minute with a work email or 10 with a personal email.
